name: Maverick
caption: Billed "the Extreme Icon," held the Extreme Television Championship into the federation's opening surviving card before losing it to Viglen on 4 March 1997.

tenures.source: The federation's 25 February, 4 March and 12 March 1997 cards (as Extreme Television Champion, then challenger), and the 30 November 1997 battle royal (eliminated).

name: The Playboy (Ronnie D.)
caption: Lost a title match to Maverick on the federation's opening surviving card, then won the vacant-in-all-but-name Extreme Internet Championship from Warlord Chaos two weeks later.

tenures.source: The federation's 25 February 1997 card (as "the Extreme Hardcore Wrestling Champion," losing to Maverick) and 12 March 1997 card (winning the Extreme Internet Championship).

name: Viglen
caption: Won the Extreme Television Championship from Maverick on 4 March 1997 with a fan-supplied chair shot.

tenures.source: The federation's 4 March 1997 card (winning the title) and 12 March 1997 card (losing a squash match to Sexy Stallion, no longer billed champion).

name: Justin Blaze
caption: Extreme Television Champion by the federation's 12 March 1997 card, retaining twice that night; no document survives explaining how he won the title from Viglen.

tenures.source: The federation's 4 March 1997 card (defeating Hades in a non-title special challenge match) and 12 March 1997 card (retaining the Extreme Television Championship twice).

name: The X-Pert
caption: Lost an Extreme Television Championship match to Justin Blaze by submission, then cost Blaze his own next title defense by interfering on his behalf.

tenures.source: The federation's 12 March 1997 card.

name: Bloodhound
caption: A recurring midcarder who lost a submission match to Ivan Thor Thunder, then fought Justin Blaze to a Television Championship disqualification after X-Pert's interference.

tenures.source: The federation's 4 March 1997 card (an Internet Tag Team Tournament bout, and a submission loss to Ivan Thor Thunder) and 12 March 1997 card (a double count-out with Red Panther; an Extreme Television Championship match against Justin Blaze).
